name: Reader Rabbit Kart Racing
summary: Reader Rabbit Kart Racing is a character-driven racing game featuring familiar faces from the Reader Rabbit edutainment series. Players can choose from four characters: Reader Rabbit, Sam the Lion, Matilda the Mouse, and Charlie the Chipmunk; each with their own kart, and race across 12 vibrant tracks, including six reversed variants. The racetracks span cheerful environments like forests and hillsides, designed to evoke a playful atmosphere. Gameplay options include Time Attack, Single Race, and Tournament modes. As players race, they can collect alphabet letters scattered along the tracks to unlock surprises from Reader Rabbit.
